notes: Fixed: Needs Review was showing every SMS the app couldn't parse, including recharge alerts, delivery updates, and marketing texts - not just real bank/payment activity. The app still reads every message the same as before, but Needs Review now only surfaces ones that actually look like a bank or payment app trying to tell you something. This update also does a one-time cleanup of everything already sitting in your Needs Review list, so you'll immediately see it shrink to just the genuine ones instead of only affecting messages from now on.
